root_family.canonical_name: Occupational Safety, Personal Protective Equipment & Workwear
root_family.definition: Steel-toe industrial safety shoes, high-visibility reflective vests, hard hats, welding safety goggles, and chemical respirator masks.

translations.am: የስራ ላይ ደህንነት እና የጥበቃ አልባሳት (ሴፍቲ ጫማ፣ ቆብ)

children.canonical_name: Steel-Toe Safety Boots & Industrial Hard Hats (ሴፍቲ ጫማ)
children.definition: Puncture-resistant steel-toe work boots (Caterpillar, Delta Plus) and ABS dielectric construction safety helmets.

translations.am: የብረት አፍ ሴፍቲ ጫማዎች እና የግንባታ ቆቦች
translations.ti: ናይ ብረት ኣፍ ሴፍቲ ሳእኒታትን ቆብዕን
